title: Talk Test
prerequisites: Observe how speaking feels during the activity; do not manufacture a measurement.
limitations: This is a practical relative-effort method, not a VO2max estimate, calorie calculation or universal heart-rate zone. Activity speeds and heart rates are not interchangeable between people.
stopRules: Stop and seek appropriate help for concerning symptoms; the talk test does not grant medical clearance.

claims.text: The CDC talk test describes relative aerobic effort: moderate effort generally allows conversation but not singing; vigorous effort generally allows only a few words before pausing for breath.

review.reviewer: Codex source verification and machine validation; personal use; no human review
